brief: The Claude Code stack a one-person founder uses to ship like a 10-person team.

slots.title: 1. Figma, the designer
slots.body: Design wireframes and high-fidelity UI in Figma. Ship prototypes fast without waiting on a design team.

slots.title: 2. Next.js, the frontend
slots.body: Build the UI with Next.js App Router, React Server Components, and TypeScript for type-safe, fast pages.

slots.title: 3. Supabase, the backend
slots.body: Use Supabase for Postgres, auth, and real-time subscriptions. Stop managing infrastructure and just write product logic.

slots.title: 4. Claude, the engineer
slots.body: Let Claude Code write, debug, and refactor across your codebase. It handles boilerplate so you focus on logic.

slots.title: 5. Vercel, the deployer
slots.body: Deploy to Vercel for global edge CDN, preview branches, and zero-config CI. Push to main and go live instantly.

slots.title: 6. Linear, the tracker
slots.body: Track tasks and sprints in Linear. Keep a tight feedback loop without standups or project-management overhead.
